versions.changelog:
Huawei Cloud Capacity Assessment skill initial release.

- Assesses cloud instance capacity across 21 services using monitoring data from hcloud CES and AOM.
- Computes peak/valley ratios, pressure coefficients, and predicts traffic ceilings for scale-out recommendations.
- Supports four modes: single-instance historical, full historical, single-instance T-24, and full T-24.
- Automates data collection, computation, and Excel template read/write; no manual intervention required.
- Includes built-in error handling, templating, and cleanup with clear user reporting for results and failures.
